descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-10 ER 6; TFA-92588 AC 8; UAT 3.7 · “Yesterday's panels are never silently reused.”.

Bug B05 · S0 · known

After a failed summary retry, today's note contains yesterday-only values; a partial summary still says '✓ Note saved' and yesterday's one-liner and chest X-ray stay on the panel without notice

Tickets: TFA-92592 ready for qa; TFA-92588 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: no (fix in PR #100/#101) · found on: dev + local

Note: Re-test 2026-10-15 on 43c38a4f: the Hospital note half is fixed on dev (TC-10/S12); still there: the Nursing Home summary and note present yesterday's values as current (no backgroundContext: yesterday's 38.2 °C as 'low-grade fever', K 5.9 as current), and a partial summary still shows plain success with yesterday's one-liner and chest X-ray (TC-10/S26 R2). Counted again because both tickets are ready for QA now.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-10/S26

Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S12 Day 2, failed summary on file: dictation kept, error, Generate disabled; Save Note again succeeds and unlocks Generate; yesterday-only vitals and labs never reach today's note (both modes)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 If the summary call fails: the raw dictation is kept, an explicit error shows, and Generate is disabled until a Save succeeds (PR #53). Yesterday's panels are never silently reused. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 8; TFA-94745 state 3; UAT Empty & Failure States)
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)
  • T4 The summary-failed state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's style (never a blank screen, crash, raw error pop-up or invented content), loses nothing typed or dictated, appears only af … (TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT 3.5)
  • U14 Today's note never includes a vital or lab not refreshed today, and if no vitals were dictated today it says so. Vitals, labs and imaging each show the date they were recorded (dated panels are not o … (UAT 3.7; UAT 3.4)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident seeded (spec.seed) with yesterday's processed pre-round and panels (20 h old, including fields today's text does not mention) and today's dictation saved by a failed summary (preRoundError set)

When Open each chart: editor, Encounter tab; then Save Note again (the local model answers), look at the panels, go back to Encounter, press Generate Note & Finish and open the note

Then Before the retry: today's dictation is in the box, an explicit error says to tap Save Note to retry, Generate is disabled. After the retry: no error, the panels show today's values and not yesterday's BP, Generate is enabled. Today's note has today's values and none of the yesterday-only temp, O2 or labs (3.7). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): scripts/oracle.mjs: cp1/cp6 contain today's dictation and an instruction to retry; cp2/cp7 show Generate Note & Finish [disabled]; cp3/cp8 show today's values, not yesterday's BP (150/90, 148/88), no retry message; cp4/cp9 Generate not disabled; cp5/cp10 today's note has today's BP and none of 38.9 / 91% / 3.1 (Hospital) or 38.2 / 5.9 (Nursing Home), per U14. …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92588 ready for qa; TFA-94745 ready for qa; TFA-92592 ready for qa

After a failed pre-round summary and a successful retry, today's generated note still contains yesterday-only values (Hospital temp 38.9, O2 91%, lab 3.1; Nursing Home 38.2, 5.9). The Nursing Home panel also shows yesterday's BP 148/88 with no date.

Evidence: Dev report §2 #2 and ledger #66 (U66), allure c49b4e99. The fix is in open PR #100/#101 (TFA-92592 rework, cluster V). It ran in the rest tier because TFA-92588 is at ready for pr. The failure-state parts pass: dictation kept, the 'tap Save Note' error shows, and Generate stays disabled until the retry.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev/newspec-c.
